parsed_results.text: This isn't about doing more. It's about running the job once.
We retried failed notifications, not failed payments.
Unlike Lee et al. [4], we found no improvement in the smaller sample.
The deployment finally worked. My celebratory dance was mercifully undocumented.
The cache may reduce latency by roughly 10% for repeated requests; cold starts are untested.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype aims to detect duplicate invoices. We have not tested its accuracy. It may help the finance team.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope while limiting the effect of outliers.
The migration is complete. "Ready to launch," the manager said. We still need to check the backups.

Update for the team: on Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. Median latency fell from 80 ms to 60 ms for repeated requests in our 30-minute test. We have not tested cold starts or the other eight servers. It may reduce support tickets, but that's unverified. Also, the dashboard still shows yesterday's data.

Before release:
- Verify the signature.
- Verify the checksum.
- Verify the version.
